Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) is a Windows feature that hands VRAM management directly to your GPU which should help reduce CPU bottleneck.

HAGS must be enabled in order to use DLSS. DLSS is only rarely a feature found in PCVR games.

It's also known to either improve or degrade performance in some VR games as well.

__**How to disable HAGS:**__

**Automatic: **
In the Virtual Desktop Streamer click About find HAGS. If it's enabled and you want to disable it, click the option to disable. Your PC will reboot and it will be disabled.

**Manual:**
1. Open Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics (or Graphics Settings).

2. Click Advanced Graphics Settings.

3. Toggle Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling to Off.

4. Restart your PC for the change to take effect.
